locked_analysis_fields.multiplicity_procedure: per-event max-over-candidate-windows permutation p, then BH across declared events
locked_analysis_fields.failure_reporting: all prespecified events and gates, including failures

e_assignment.E0: unsupported, non-estimable, non-identifiable, artifact-dominated or missing required design, with one stable reason code
e_assignment.E1: valid event test supports the event but block robustness/mode/stability gates for E2 are not all met
e_assignment.E2: valid event support plus independent-block robustness, identifiable mode, required controls and no upstream-disagreement gate
e_assignment.resampling_gate: events with discovery_stability_status=unstable cannot receive unconditional E2

unmasking_rule: outcome may be opened only after RNA/activity outputs, E/mode/artifact calls, reason codes, manifest and checksums are frozen
activation_blockers: gene-set hashes and event families not yet locked
outcome custodian or cryptographic masking procedure not yet recorded
